title: Child not safe in custody of woman who doesn't care for husband: Pune court
description: A family court in Pune recently granted interim custody of a 10-year-old boy to his father, observing that the wife did not appear to respect her husband, maintain the household or nurture the home.Judge Ganesh Ghule said that such values appeared to be “foreign terms” to her and thus held that the child’s future was not safe in her custody.“Pious duties of a wife towards her husband, nurturing the home, maintaining the respect, providing emotional support in traditional and religious perspectiv
